mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END id, case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END text FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
and (instr(TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{search}) > 0)

select SEC_ACCT_ID id, SEC_ACCT_NAME text from STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO
and (instr(SEC_ACCT_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(SEC_ACCT_NAME, #{search}) > 0)
mapper.sql:
and T1.PORTFOLIO_ID is null
AND ( ( T1.PS != 'T39' AND T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} ) OR ( T1.PS = 'T39' AND exists ( select 1 from trd_product_deal tpd WHERE ((TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND t1.trade_status != '03' ) OR ( TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.P_TRADE_ID AND t1.trade_status = '03' )) and tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} ) ) )
AND T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
AND T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE = #{paBizType}
AND T1.MDATE >= to_date(#{mdateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.MDATE <= to_date(#{mdateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND T1.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')

select.if:
SELECT #{statusValid} statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PS cashType,
T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,
nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, T1.FEE_AMT channelFee, NVL(T1.FPRICE_AMT,T1.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel,
T1.FINPROD_ID, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/,
T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole/*起息日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole/*到期日*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory/*理论应计利息*/, T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory/*理论还本金额*/, T1.INT_AMT intAmt/*实收利息总额*/,
to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE/*资金到账日*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarket, T1.SHARE_AMT qty, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt/*理论本息总额*/, T1.TRADE_AMT/*实收本息总额*/, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId, t3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, T1.IS_CLEAN FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T1.CHL_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND ((T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}) or (T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}))

SELECT distinct
T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode,
T1.P_TRADE_ID busiCode,
T1.PS cashType,
T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID,
nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, T1.FEE_AMT channelFee, NVL(T1.FPRICE_AMT,T1.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel,
T1.FINPROD_ID, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, to_char(T1.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/,
T3.UNIT_INT unitIntAmt/*单位应计利息*/, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole/*起息日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole/*到期日*/, T3.UNIT_PRIN intPrinAmt/*单位本金*/, T3.PRIN prinAmt/*还本面额/百元*/, T3.RATE*100 yield/*区间票面利率（%）*/, to_char(T3.THEORY_PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate/*支付日*/, T3.THEORY_INT intAmtTheory/*理论应计利息*/, T3.THEORY_PRIN prinAmtTheory/*理论还本金额*/, T1.INT_AMT intAmt/*实收利息总额*/, DEAL.CANCEL_REMARK revokeReason, to_char(T1.SETTLE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE/*资金到账日*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE tradeMarket, T1.SHARE_AMT*100 qty, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt/*理论本息总额*/, T1.TRADE_AMT/*实收本息总额*/, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId,
NVL(t3.PA_BUSS_TYPE,T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE) PA_BUSS_TYPE,
T1.IS_CLEAN FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T1.CHL_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01}
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N}
AND T1.P_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03}

SELECT t1.*, ROUND(100 - SUM(NVL(fcp.prin_amt, 0)), 6) intPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT #{statusValid} statusValid, t8.CASH_ID cashId, t8.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE, SUM(T8.QTY)*100 QTY, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, NULL channelFee, NULL tradeAmtReal,
CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, TO_CHAR(t8.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, TO_CHAR(t8.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, ROUND(t8.INT_AMT, 12) unitIntAmt,/*单位应计利息*/ TO_CHAR(T10.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole,/*起息日*/ TO_CHAR(T10.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole,/*到期日*/ ROUND(t8.PRIN_AMT, 4) prinAmt,/*还本面额/百元*/ T8.RANGE_YIELD*100 yield,/*区间票面利率（%）*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate,/*支付日*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate,/*交易日*/ ROUND(sum(T8.intAmt), 8) intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ ROUND(sum(T8.prinAmt), 4) prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T10.TRADE_MARKET, ROUND(sum(t8.fpriceAmt), 4) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ NULL PA_BUSS_TYPE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT QTY, listagg(T1.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_TYPE, listagg(T1.CASH_ID, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_ID, min(T1.VDATE) VDATE, T1.MDATE, SUM(T1.CASH_AMT * T1.AMOUNT) fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ sum(case when T1.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01}, '04') then 0 else T1.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT end) prinAmt, max(T1.INT_PRIN_AMT) INT_PRIN_AMT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(T1.PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT, SUM(T1.INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(T1.int_amt * T1.AMOUNT) intAmt, /*理论利息*/ T1.PAY_DATE, max(t1.RANGE_YIELD) RANGE_YIELD from (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID,
DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1,'11', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, DECODE(T1.INV_AIM, 'SELL', '999999', T1.INV_AIM) INV_AIM,
T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, t2.vdate, t2.mdate, t2.cash_amt, t2.prin_amt, t2.INT_PRIN_AMT, t2.int_amt, t2.cash_id, t2.cash_type, t2.pay_date, t2.RANGE_YIELD FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND t1.CDATE < t2.MDATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
INNER JOIN DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST dani on dani.BUSINESS_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID AND dani.DATA_TYPE ='PTL01' AND dani.INSTITUTION_CODE=#{institutionCode}
WHERE T1.AMOUNT > 0
AND T1.HODING_TYPE IN ('03', '05', '06','11')
and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secManageAcctId} AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T2.MDATE = to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and T2.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE03},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE04}) and (t2.INT_AMT > 0 or t2.PRIN_AMT > 0) /*不存在生效的交易*/ and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND TPDA.INSTITUTION_CODE = #{institutionCode}
AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) /*不存在流程中的当期或之前的交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < t2.MDATE )
) T1 group by T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.MDATE,T1.AMOUNT,T1.INV_AIM, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.PAY_DATE) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01}
and T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
GROUP BY t8.CASH_ID , t8.CASH_TYPE, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID,SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME,SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID, t8.PRIN_AMT, t8.INT_AMT/*还本金额*/, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME , t8.VDATE, t8.MDATE, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.VDATE, T10.MDATE, T8.RANGE_YIELD , T8.PAY_DATE , T10.TRADE_MARKET, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE ) T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp ON #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} = fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2 AND fcp.MDATE < to_date(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fcp.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02}) and fcp.PRIN_AMT > 0 GROUP BY t1.statusValid, t1. cashId, t1.CASH_TYPE, t1.QTY, t1.secManageAcctId, t1.channel, t1.secAcctName, t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t1.finprodMarketName, t1.vDate, t1.mDate, t1.FINPROD_ID, t1.CCY, t1.unitIntAmt , t1.vDateWhole , t1.mDateWhole , t1.prinAmt , t1.yield , t1.payDate , t1.tradeDate , t1.intAmtTheory , t1.prinAmtTheory , t1.TRADE_MARKET, t1.fpriceAmt , t1.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t1.collectType

mapper.select: SELECT SUM(COUNT) FROM ( select count(1) COUNT from LQD_PIPELINE_MATCH T1 INNER join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T2 on T2.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.SYS_TRADE_ID or t2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID=t1.SYS_TRADE_ID WHERE T2.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} or t2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} UNION ALL select count (1) COUNT from LQD_PIPELINE_MATCH T1 INNER join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 on T2.TRADE_ID = T1.SYS_TRADE_ID WHERE T1.SYS_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} )

SELECT PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.INV_AIM, NVL(NVL(FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME), PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID) SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(PSP.AMOUNT)*100 qty, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM ( SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.INV_AIM, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1, '04', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1
T1.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} AND T1.CDATE <= to_date(#{exerciseDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.HODING_TYPE IN ('03', '04', '06', '08')
and T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION TT1 WHERE T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = TT1.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = TT1.SEC_ACCT_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = TT1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = TT1.BRANCH AND T1.INV_AIM = TT1.INV_AIM AND T1.HODING_TYPE = TT1.HODING_TYPE AND T1.CDATE < TT1.CDATE and tt1.cdate <= to_date(#{exerciseDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') )
UNION ALL SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.INV_AIM, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW T1
T1.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} AND T1.CDATE <= to_date(#{exerciseDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.HODING_TYPE IN ('01')
and T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FP.FINPROD_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
) PSP INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.INV_AIM, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_NAME,FP.FINPROD_ABBR, FP.FINPROD_NAME HAVING SUM(PSP.AMOUNT) > 0
select TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID in (SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} ) and PS = 'T23' and TRADE_STATUS = '01'

SELECT t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as bizCode, t1.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, t2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, t2.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodName, t1.VDATE as vdate, t1.MDATE as mdate, t1.TRADE_DATE as payDate, t1.SHARE_AMT * t1.PAR_VALUE as qty, t1.UNIT_CPRICE as netPrice, t1.UNIT_CPRICE * t1.SHARE_AMT as cPriceAmt, t1.FPRICE_AMT as fPriceAmt, t1.SETTLE_DATE as settleDate FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL t1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT t2 on t1.FINPROD_ID = t2.FINPROD_ID WHERE t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totalTradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as totalTradeId, t1.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, t3.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, t1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID as secAcctId, t1.INV_AIM as invAim, t1.SHARE_AMT * t1.PAR_VALUE as qty, t1.UNIT_CPRICE * t1.SHARE_AMT as cPriceAmt, t1.FPRICE_AMT as settleAmt FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL t1 inner join TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD t2 on t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO t3 on t1.PORTFOLIO_ID = t3.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE t1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totalTradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
